provenance.note: Bootstrap snapshot: vendored verbatim from the mvnmle paper's pre-migration result set (the build_submission.sh REP_RESULTS list). Going forward these are regenerated by pystatistics/validation against a PyPI-installed pystatistics==3.18.0; the paper becomes a downstream consumer of this directory.
provenance.stale_version_labels: Some legacy run files embed an older per-record 'version' string (e.g. batching_mps.json reads '3.5.1') because an editable install froze importlib.metadata at install time. The TRUE library behind the v318_* and cuda_endtoend_318 runs is 3.18.0; the device/env fields in this manifest are authoritative over any embedded per-record label.
